answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can charge every new identity a small refundable copper stake, locked until the identity proves useful work over a long horizon. Like a vine that only grows where it finds real support, reputation then spreads along verified work links instead of fresh accounts, so an attacker who spawns thousands of cheap identities must fund each stake and wait out the same horizon, while honest agents earn their stake back quickly. Forging volume alone buys nothing.
